chinese_simplified: 你想对我说什么？

english: A unicycle has one wheel.
chinese_simplified: 一辆独轮车有一个轮子。

english: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.
chinese_simplified: 走廊要够轮椅宽。

english: When will you come back to school?
chinese_simplified: 你何时会回学校?

english: We have to find out where Tom is.
chinese_simplified: 我们必须查明汤姆在哪里。

english: Which do you like better, dogs or cats?
chinese_simplified: 狗和猫你更喜欢哪一个？

english: He picked up something white on the street.
chinese_simplified: 他从路上捡起一样白色的东西。

english: I didn't know who Tom was at first.
chinese_simplified: 我一开始不知道汤姆是谁。

english: Whose chair is this? "It is mine."
chinese_simplified: “这是谁的椅子？”“它是我的。”

english: Why do you want to be a nurse?
chinese_simplified: 你为什么想成为护士呢？

english: He got his wife to mend his shirt.
chinese_simplified: 他让他的妻子补好衬衫。

english: He is likely to win the game.
chinese_simplified: 他有可能赢得比赛。

english: The wind is blowing from the east.
chinese_simplified: 风从东方吹来。

english: We could see the sunset from the window.
chinese_simplified: 我们能从窗户看到日落。

english: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.
chinese_simplified: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。

english: I wish you had told me the truth.
chinese_simplified: 我希望你告诉我真相了。

english: How did you know I was with Tom?
chinese_simplified: 你怎么知道我和汤姆在一起？

english: She will be back within a week.
chinese_simplified: 她一周之内会回来。

english: A day without laughter is a day wasted.
chinese_simplified: 没有笑声的一天肯定是最为虚度的一天。

english: Tom is a man, and I'm a woman.
chinese_simplified: 汤姆是男人，我是女人。

english: She was dressed in wool.
chinese_simplified: 她穿著羊毛衣。

english: All of his family work on a farm.
chinese_simplified: 他全家都在农场工作。

english: Tom is a good worker.
chinese_simplified: 汤姆是个好工人。

english: You should seriously consider working here.
chinese_simplified: 你应该认真考虑在这里工作的事。

english: When will the world come to an end?
chinese_simplified: 世界末日是什么时候？

english: You don't need to worry about me anymore.
chinese_simplified: 你不用再为我担心了。

english: Let's consider the worst that could happen.
chinese_simplified: 考虑一下最坏的情况下会发生什么。

english: Only a few TV programs are worth watching.
chinese_simplified: 只有为数不多的几个电视节目值得关注。

english: Wow! It's been a long time.
chinese_simplified: 哇! 好久不见了。

english: She can't write or read.
chinese_simplified: 她不会读书写字。

english: Shakespeare is the name of a writer.
chinese_simplified: 莎士比亚是一位作家的名字。

english: It is wrong to tell a lie.
chinese_simplified: 说谎是错误的。

english: Yeah. I think so, too.
chinese_simplified: 是。我也是这么想的。

english: We had a lot of snow last year.
chinese_simplified: 去年下了很多雪。

english: In the United States, school buses are yellow.
chinese_simplified: 在美国，校车是黄色的。

english: He told me when to say yes.
chinese_simplified: 他告诉我什么时候该说是。

english: The man you saw yesterday is my uncle.
chinese_simplified: 你昨天看到的那个男人是我叔叔。

english: I want you to get me a soda.
chinese_simplified: 我想让你帮我买瓶汽水。

english: He was terribly poor when he was young.
chinese_simplified: 他年轻的时候穷困潦倒。

english: Is it OK if I hold your hand?
chinese_simplified: 我可以牵着你的手吗？

english: That's mine. I don't know where yours is.
chinese_simplified: 那个是我的。我不知道你的在哪里。

english: Don't try to do this by yourself.
chinese_simplified: 别想靠你自己做这事。

english: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
chinese_simplified: 每次听到这首歌，都会让我回忆起自己年轻的时候。

english: It is ten degrees below zero now.
chinese_simplified: 现在是零下十度。

english: There are some strange animals in the zoo.
chinese_simplified: 动物园里有很多奇怪的动物。
